purpose: Abstract linework, texture and shading reference with no recognizable subjects or scenes; output colors come from each subject description.
editPrompts: Edit and distill the four supplied PV screenshots into ONE square abstract drawing-style reference canvas. Treat all four images as sources of mark-making and material treatment only. Remove all recognizable people, faces, hair, clothing, objects, buildings, plants, landscapes, celestial bodies, symbols, logos, subtitles and player UI. Preserve the shared drawing qualities: flowing tapered contours, crisp flat paper-cut silhouettes, interlocking angular planes, two or three painted value levels, fine parallel engraving-like hatching, subtle printed-paper grain and restrained dry-brush marks. Recompose these qualities into a borderless assemblage of purely nonrepresentational curved wedges, irregular polygons, tapered strips, flat tone patches and hatch/texture fields. No fragment may form an identifiable real object or scene. Keep the result flat and illustrated, without physical paper thickness, raised edges, drop shadows, craft photography or 3D rendering. Distribute neutral, warm and cool color samples evenly so no particular hue or color scheme dominates; this is a technique reference, not a palette prescription. No text, labels, numbered panels, frames or watermarks. Output only the abstract material-and-mark-making canvas.

Edit this abstract style-reference canvas. Preserve every shape, contour, overlap, hatching direction and printed texture. Change only its colors to a neutral achromatic grayscale spanning white, light gray, middle gray, charcoal and black, retaining clear value separation and legibility of the fine marks. Remove all color casts. Keep it a flat 2D nonrepresentational illustration with no identifiable objects or scenery, no physical paper thickness or drop shadows, and no text. This canvas will teach drawing texture and shading while the destination prompts independently choose colors.
